source.scope: Fresh public CPU controls after all GPU/independent work finishes.

sequential-refine.scope: Fresh native CGAL Mesh_3 with feature protection, optional ODT, perturbation then exudation. Complete time includes domain construction, meshing and optimization; prepared-domain time excludes domain construction. File I/O, triangulation validation, serialization and independent quality checks are separate. No GPU speedup is inferred by this runner.

independent_quality.scope: Independent NumPy solves, face/edge incidence and CGAL AABB triangle distances with float64 constructions; outside mesher timing. Three quadrature points per boundary face, not a Hausdorff certificate.

distance_oracle.implementation: CGAL AABB triangle distances with float64 constructions

independent.scope: Review every completed CPU control, including mixed valid/invalid repeated outputs.
independent.limits: Three repeats per setting, including all invalid and throttled outcomes. Every initially valid output receives vertex-link and exact self-intersection checks; all rejected controls remain explicit. This is not a quality-matched speedup comparison.
